# Ozon
> Ozon is a major Russian e-commerce marketplace for shopping, selling, logistics, and business services.

Ozon operates consumer retail, marketplace seller tools, advertising, fulfillment, and financial services. Its web presence spans the main storefront, seller and partner documentation, business APIs, and corporate information.

## Main Platform
- [Ozon Home](https://www.ozon.ru/): Main marketplace homepage for shopping across electronics, fashion, home, and everyday goods.
- [Catalog](https://www.ozon.ru/category/): Entry point to product categories and storefront navigation.
- [Brands](https://www.ozon.ru/brand/): Brand landing pages and curated product selections from manufacturers.
- [Premium](https://www.ozon.ru/highlight/premium/): Membership program with delivery, discounts, and service benefits.
- [Travel](https://www.ozon.ru/travel/): Travel booking section integrated into the Ozon platform.
- [Jobs](https://job.ozon.ru/): Careers portal for corporate, logistics, technology, and operations roles.

## Buyer Help
- [Help Center](https://docs.ozon.ru/common/): Customer help center for orders, delivery, returns, payments, and account issues.
- [Ordering](https://docs.ozon.ru/common/zakazy/): Guidance on placing, managing, and tracking customer orders.
- [Delivery](https://docs.ozon.ru/common/dostavka/): Information about shipping methods, pickup points, and delivery timing.
- [Returns and Refunds](https://docs.ozon.ru/common/vozvrat/): Policies and instructions for returning items and receiving refunds.
- [Payments](https://docs.ozon.ru/common/oplata/): Payment methods, billing, and transaction-related support information.
- [Account and Security](https://docs.ozon.ru/common/akkaunt/): Account settings, access, personal data, and security help.

## Seller Documentation
- [Seller Docs Home](https://docs.ozon.ru/global/): Main documentation hub for marketplace sellers and partners.
- [Getting Started](https://docs.ozon.ru/global/start/): Introductory materials for launching sales on the Ozon marketplace.
- [Products](https://docs.ozon.ru/global/products/): Rules and workflows for creating, editing, and managing product listings.
- [Prices and Promotions](https://docs.ozon.ru/global/prices/): Pricing controls, discounts, and promotional campaign documentation.
- [Orders](https://docs.ozon.ru/global/orders/): Seller order processing, statuses, cancellations, and fulfillment operations.
- [Analytics](https://docs.ozon.ru/global/analytics/): Reporting and performance metrics for sellers and marketplace operations.
- [Finance](https://docs.ozon.ru/global/finance/): Payouts, commissions, balances, and financial document guidance.
- [Returns](https://docs.ozon.ru/global/returns/): Seller-side return handling, claims, and compensation processes.

## Fulfillment and Logistics
- [FBO](https://docs.ozon.ru/global/fbo/): Fulfillment by Ozon documentation for warehouse-based order handling.
- [FBS](https://docs.ozon.ru/global/fbs/): Fulfillment by Seller workflows for packing, shipping, and handoff.
- [RealFBS](https://docs.ozon.ru/global/realfbs/): Seller-managed delivery model with direct logistics integration.
- [Warehouses](https://docs.ozon.ru/global/warehouses/): Warehouse operations, supply rules, and inventory placement guidance.
- [Supply Management](https://docs.ozon.ru/global/posting/): Shipment creation and supply preparation for Ozon logistics.
- [Crossborder](https://docs.ozon.ru/global/crossborder/): Documentation for international selling and cross-border marketplace operations.

## Seller API
- [API Overview](https://docs.ozon.ru/api/seller/): Overview of Ozon Seller API capabilities and integration patterns.
- [API Reference](https://docs.ozon.ru/api/seller/#operation/): Endpoint reference for products, orders, finance, and logistics operations.
- [Authentication](https://docs.ozon.ru/api/seller/#section/Avtorizaciya): Authentication requirements and credentials for Seller API access.
- [Products API](https://docs.ozon.ru/api/seller/#tag/ProductAPI): Endpoints for product data, attributes, and content management.
- [FBS API](https://docs.ozon.ru/api/seller/#tag/Fbs): Operations for seller fulfillment, postings, and shipment processing.
- [Finance API](https://docs.ozon.ru/api/seller/#tag/Finance): Financial reports, transactions, and payout-related API methods.
- [Analytics API](https://docs.ozon.ru/api/seller/#tag/Analytics): Programmatic access to reports and seller performance data.

## Ozon for Business
- [Ozon Seller](https://seller.ozon.ru/): Seller portal for marketplace operations, catalog, orders, and business management.
- [Ozon Business](https://business.ozon.ru/): B2B purchasing and procurement services for companies.
- [Ozon Bank](https://bank.ozon.ru/): Financial products and banking services for users and businesses.
- [Ozon Rocket](https://rocket.ozon.ru/): Logistics and delivery services for merchants and partners.
- [Ozon fresh](https://www.ozon.ru/category/supermarket-25000/): Grocery and fast-delivery shopping section on the marketplace.
- [Advertising](https://ads.ozon.ru/): Advertising platform for promoting products and brands within Ozon.

## Partners and Developers
- [Partner Portal](https://partners.ozon.ru/): Entry point for technology, logistics, and business partnership programs.
- [Developer Docs](https://docs.ozon.ru/): Central documentation index covering customer, seller, and API materials.
- [Seller Integrations](https://docs.ozon.ru/api/seller/): Technical documentation for integrating seller systems with Ozon.
- [Webhook and Events](https://docs.ozon.ru/api/seller/#section/Webhooki): Event delivery and webhook configuration for marketplace integrations.
- [Content Requirements](https://docs.ozon.ru/global/products/requirements/): Product content standards, validation rules, and listing requirements.
- [Attribute Dictionary](https://docs.ozon.ru/api/seller/#tag/CategoryAPI): Category and attribute methods for structured catalog integration.

## Corporate
- [About Ozon](https://corp.ozon.ru/): Corporate site with company overview, strategy, and business segments.
- [Investor Relations](https://corp.ozon.ru/investors/): Financial results, disclosures, governance, and investor materials.
- [Press Center](https://corp.ozon.ru/press-center/): Company news, announcements, and media resources.
- [Sustainability](https://corp.ozon.ru/esg/): ESG strategy, social impact, and sustainability reporting.
- [Corporate Governance](https://corp.ozon.ru/investors/corporate-governance/): Governance structure, board information, and corporate policies.
- [Contacts](https://corp.ozon.ru/contacts/): Corporate contact information for media, investors, and partners.

## Policies and Legal
- [Terms of Use](https://www.ozon.ru/legal/terms/): General platform terms governing use of Ozon services.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.ozon.ru/legal/privacy/): Personal data processing and privacy practices for platform users.
- [Seller Agreement](https://docs.ozon.ru/global/commissions/): Seller commercial terms, fees, and marketplace conditions.
- [Return Rules](https://docs.ozon.ru/common/vozvrat/): Customer-facing return conditions and refund procedures.
- [Delivery Rules](https://docs.ozon.ru/common/dostavka/): Delivery conditions, methods, and service limitations.
- [Payment Rules](https://docs.ozon.ru/common/oplata/): Payment-related conditions and supported transaction methods.
